newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 31.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syria's president is expected to arrive in Tehran on Thursday.
- Dubai plans to privatise re-export areas, which could lead to the dismissal of around 600 employees.
- Saudi and Yemeni investors set up a joint commercial group.
- A Saudi national denies accusations of being involved in the al-Khobar bombing last year in which 19 U.S. soldiers were killed.
- Washington lifts a ban on nationals travelling to Lebanon.
- The number of tourists in the Middle East is to reach 41 million in the year 2000 from 33 million now, Jordanian tourism minister says.
- Egyptian investment authority approves 12 new industrial projects with a total investment of $144.5 million.
